Synopsis:
Can't you hear anything?!

Samejima, on the verge of failing a year, asks her honor student and otaku classmate, Hayami, to teach her, promising to let her pass if he does.

Hayami readily agrees on the condition that Samejima be her drawing model, and Samejima miraculously avoids failing.

Samejima then agrees to Hayami's request, but ends up being taken advantage of by Hayami, who has become completely absorbed in her work…!?
